insight: The technology sector is rapidly shifting from general AI exploration toward highly specialized enterprise agents and complex internal infrastructure. As companies increasingly build their own proprietary software to bypass traditional SaaS models, the competitive landscape is moving beyond simple tool adoption to focus on strategic execution and safety. This evolution is further supported by an influx of venture capital and top-tier academic talent, signaling a move toward more professionalized and deeply integrated AI systems in the workplace.
